scenes.setting: The voice behind him: the old captain mutated — head split in halves, wounds full of speaking teeth ('Look, am I not normal…'); Derrick's prayed pillar of light births a featureless man of light who melts the horror, until a monocled phantom in a pointed hat flashes and everything whites out

Chief Colin Iliad, bone-sword in hand over a ten-ringed translucent worm: the captain was deliberate bait to expose Amon's design, and Derrick's Sun pathway triggered it; released home, Derrick reports all to Mr. Fool — and in his sleep his finger taps the bed: once, twice, thrice…
Post-gathering planning: the Magician's missing rules must be found fast — audience applause as digestion fuel to be tested — when layered illusory pleas interrupt
scenes.text_anchor: he heard a series of illusory, stacked pleas.
